verdict.rationale: Render's own homepage claims ephemeral previews of the entire application architecture for every change, which covers ephemeral, full-stack, per-change previews. Single-YAML Blueprints provide the multi-service definition, and Render offers isolation that keeps non-production environments away from production services. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on pull-request triggering, lifecycle and teardown, and any independent or hands-on corroboration; the evidence is homepage-level marketing copy only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request

citations.quote: Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
Define, deploy, and version your entire architecture with a single YAML file.
Prevent non-production environments from accessing production services.
